# laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key (Resource)

Manages an access key for a Laravel Cloud storage bucket.

~> **Beta:** This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_storage_bucket" "uploads" {
  name     = "my-app-uploads"
  key_name = "app"
}

# A read-write key the environment uses to reach the bucket.
resource "laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key" "app" {
  bucket_id  = laravel_cloud_storage_bucket.uploads.id
  name       = "my-app"
  permission = "read_write"
}

# A read-only key for a backup job that copies the bucket elsewhere.
resource "laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key" "backup" {
  bucket_id  = laravel_cloud_storage_bucket.uploads.id
  name       = "backup"
  permission = "read_only"
}

resource "laravel_cloud_application" "example" {
  name                         = "my-app"
  repository                   = "my-org/my-app"
  region                       = "us-east-2"
  source_control_provider_type = "github"
}

# Attach the bucket to the environment through the app key, as its default
# disk.
resource "laravel_cloud_environment" "example" {
  application_id = laravel_cloud_application.example.id
  name           = "production"
  branch         = "main"
  php_version    = "8.4:1"

  filesystem_keys = [{
    key_id          = laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key.app.id
    disk            = "s3"
    is_default_disk = true
  }]
}

# The secret is returned only when the key is created.
output "backup_access_key_id" {
  value = laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key.backup.access_key_id
}

output "backup_access_key_secret" {
  value     = laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key.backup.access_key_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) Parent storage bucket ID.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `permission` (String) Key permission: read_write or read_only.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3-compatible access key ID.
- `access_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) S3-compatible secret access key.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Keys are addressed through their bucket, so the import ID is composite.
# The API never returns access_key_secret again after creation, so an
# imported key has a null secret in state.
terraform import laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key.example "{bucket_id}:{key_id}"
```
